description: Given expected and actual values (as JSON strings), generate detailed assertion code with descriptive messages. Supports deep object comparison, array comparison, and type checking.

actual.description: The actual value as a JSON string (or plain string for primitives)

deep.description: Use deep equality for objects/arrays (default: true)

expected.description: The expected value as a JSON string (or plain string for primitives)

framework.description: Assertion framework to generate for (default: jest)

label.description: Descriptive label for the comparison (default: "value comparison")

name: generate_assertions
